standplan.title: Stall plan
standplan.prototype: Prototype · data only in this browser
standplan.subtitle: Drag requests from the Postfach onto rows and send the Platzkarte. The stall is then reserved until the transfer arrives; mark it paid afterwards (fixed).
standplan.noEvents: No upcoming events with rows. Add zones and rows to the location first.
standplan.confirmAll: {count, plural, =0 {Send Platzkarte} one {Send Platzkarte (#)} other {Send # Platzkarten}}
standplan.keysHint: Drag: drag a request from the list onto a row, move stalls on the plan. Keyboard: click a stall, then ← → moves 50 cm (1 m with Shift), ↑ ↓ changes row, Delete takes it off the plan, Esc clears the selection. Without a mouse: “Place in …” in the details.
standplan.emptyOpen: No open requests for this event.

map.label: Site plan {venue}
map.cars: {count, plural, one {# car space} other {# car spaces}}

layout.hint: Drag rows to move them, click a row to rotate it.

detail.noEmail: No email: record as paid or add an email
detail.festplatzHint: Fixed spot {year}: held on every date of this market.

toast.noRoom: No room for this in row {row}
toast.versionLoadedSkipped: “{name}” loaded; {skipped, plural, one {# stall no longer fits} other {# stalls no longer fit}} (confirmed or taken meanwhile)
toast.autoplatzWhy: Auto-place: {placed} proposed, {left} without space (reasons are shown on the requests)
toast.reserved: {count, plural, one {Platzkarte sent} other {# Platzkarten sent}}, reserved until {due} (Postfach → Sent)
toast.paid: {count, plural, one {# stall is} other {# stalls are}} now fixed
toast.paidWithVendors: {count, plural, one {# stall is} other {# stalls are}} now fixed; {added, plural, one {# new person} other {# new people}} added to the vendor list (simulated)
toast.released: Reservation of {name} ({stall}) released, no mail sent
toast.movedBooked: {name} is now on {stall}. The stall number changed; the mail to the vendor comes in a later step
toast.sweep: Reservations checked: {reminded, plural, one {# reminder} other {# reminders}} sent, {released, plural, one {# reservation} other {# reservations}} lapsed and cancelled
toast.manualCreated: Booking for {name} created; now drag it onto the plan or use “Place in …”
toast.festplatzCreated: {name}: fixed spot for {count, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}} of {market} {year} created

announce.notDraft: Only drafts can be taken off the plan; release reserved stalls with “Release”

versions.title: Versions
versions.name: Version name
versions.hint: Saves only the drafts; no mail goes out. Reserved and fixed stalls stay unchanged when loading.

why.title: Doesn't fit anywhere right now
why.gapRule: a gap exists, but it would leave pieces under 2 m (gap rule)
why.hintCar: Tip: place without a car (check with the vendor) or free a car space in a car row.
why.hintGapRule: Tip: turn off “No leftover gaps under 2 m” above or move neighbouring stalls.
why.hintPower: Tip: check power with the vendor; only rows with a power connection qualify.
why.hintSpace: Tip: move neighbouring stalls together or agree a shorter stall with the vendor.
why.more: {text} (+{count, plural, one {# more reason} other {# more reasons}})

all.carNotAllowed: No row where cars are allowed
all.gapRule: Only gaps that would leave remnants under 2 m

vendor.label: Vendor list
vendor.registeredHint: Added to the vendor list on payment (fixed) (prototype: simulated).
vendor.newHint: Joins the vendor list only once the stall is paid (fixed), so spam and bad requests stay out.

reservations.markPaid: {count, plural, =0 {Mark as paid} other {Mark # as paid}}
reservations.empty: No open reservations. Platzkarten go out from the plan via “Send Platzkarte”.
reservations.rules: Deadline and reminder come from Settings → Bookings. After the deadline an unpaid reservation is released automatically and the vendor gets a cancellation mail.
reservations.releasedTitle: {count, plural, one {# released reservation} other {# released reservations}}

manual.title: Enter a booking
manual.subtitle: {event} · {date}
manual.name: Name
manual.emailHint: Optional; needed for the Platzkarte by mail.

payment.label: Payment
payment.mailHint: As online: the Platzkarte goes out and the stall is reserved until the transfer arrives.
payment.paidHint: After placing, “Record as paid”: the stall is fixed and no mail goes out.
payment.noEmail: Without an email there's no Platzkarte by mail; the booking is recorded as paid.

festplatz.intro: Fixed spots for {market} {year}: the stall is held on every date of the year.
festplatz.empty: No fixed spots yet. Click a stall (reserved or fixed) and choose “Make fixed spot”.
festplatz.manageHint: Exceptions: untick a date when the vendor won't come. The stall is free on that date.
festplatz.paymentOpen: Payment for fixed spots is still open (question for the owner).
